signal.title: How to Evaluate General-Purpose Robot Policies for Real-World Deployment
signal.summary: 这项研究围绕视觉—语言—动作模型展开，关注机器人如何把视觉观察和语言指令，持续转换成跨时间的动作，而不是只对当前画面做一次反应。

editorial.intro: 这项研究围绕视觉—语言—动作模型展开，关注机器人如何把视觉观察和语言指令，持续转换成跨时间的动作，而不是只对当前画面做一次反应。
editorial.why_it_matters: VLA 的记忆、推理和实时执行能力，直接决定具身智能能否从演示动作走向长时任务和真实部署。
editorial.watch_next: 继续核对实验是否覆盖真实机器人、长时任务和跨场景泛化。

evidence.excerpt: How to Evaluate General-Purpose Robot Policies for Real-World Deployment | NVIDIA Technical Blog DEVELOPER Home Blog Forums Docs Downloads Training Join Technical Blog Subscribe Related Resources Robotics English 中文 How to Evaluate General-Purpose Robot Policies for Real-World Deployment Jul 11, 2026 By Xuning Yang Like Discuss (0) L T F R E AI-Generated Summary Like Dislike RoboLab, developed by NVIDIA Research, addresses critical shortcomings in robotics policy evaluation by enabling robot-agnostic benchmarking with rapid, scalable task and scene generation, overcoming issues of visual/task-domain overlap, benchmark saturation, and high setup overhead seen in prior benchmarks. The platform integrates advanced diagnostic tools: graded task scores for partial credit, trajectory quality via SPARC for motion smoothness, and detailed failure event logging, providing fine-grained analysis on policy performance, robustness to language, scene, and task complexity, and supporting sensitivity analysis using Neural Posterior Estimation to quantify environmental variable impacts.
